description: Promote Ledger triggers on every push to main regardless of path and stays silently green when HOLON_LEDGER_BOT_TOKEN is unset, causing 15/20 cancelled workflow runs per merge burst while 270 pending fragments pile up.
goal: In .github/workflows/promote-ledger.yml: (1) eliminate per-merge cancelled run storms by removing the unguarded on.push trigger (using periodic schedule + workflow_dispatch, or debounced pending-ledger path filtering); (2) when HOLON_LEDGER_BOT_TOKEN is absent, emit an explicit warning naming the pending fragment count and required maintainer secret action instead of a silent notice green no-op; (3) update .github/workflows/README.md to document the updated promote-ledger.yml triggers and warning behaviour; (4) add unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_promote_ledger_workflow.py asserting the workflow triggers, non-silent warning behavior, and self-explaining YAML compliance. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Stopping per-push no-op trigger storms cuts 75% of workflow cancellations on main while surfacing unpromoted fragment backlogs loudly.
acceptance_criteria: `.github/workflows/promote-ledger.yml` avoids per-merge cancelled run storms by removing the unguarded `on.push` trigger (relying on periodic `schedule` + `workflow_dispatch`, or `paths: ['holon-knowledge/ledger/pending/**']` with debounced cadence).

When `HOLON_LEDGER_BOT_TOKEN` is absent, `.github/workflows/promote-ledger.yml` checks out the pending directory count (or emits an explicit `::warning::` naming the pending fragment backlog and action required rather than a silent `::notice::` green no-op), and `.github/workflows/README.md` documents the updated trigger and warning behaviour.

Unit tests in `apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_promote_ledger_workflow.py` assert the workflow triggers, non-silent warning behavior, and self-explaining YAML compliance via `uv run pytest`, and `uv run task lint` passes.
